glass.edge_margin_note: the two interface ports sit exactly on the 150 mm board edge (centreline margin 0), so the -25 um edge margin is a known property of the exploratory centreline model and is not counted as a glass violation here

self_clearance.note: pairs with arc-length separation <= 1 mm are excluded (local path neighbourhood, same convention as fsd25d.world25d.self_clearance_violations)

crossing_exemption_policy.same_physical_height_rule: strict D56 2-D centreline clearance 0.08 mm (width 0.05 + edge gap 0.03); legal transverse crossings exempt
crossing_exemption_policy.different_physical_height_rule: legal when |dz| >= 0.05 mm; XY overlap alone is not a violation
crossing_exemption_policy.transition_rule: true 3-D centreline distance >= 0.05 mm to every other route (transition-vs-flat, transition-vs-transition)
